```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Filter the data for the top 10 most common dog breeds
top_breeds = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().nlargest(10).index
top_breeds_df = df[df['Rasse1Text'].isin(top_breeds)]

# Create a count plot for dog breeds
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.countplot(data=top_breeds_df, y='Rasse1Text', order=top_breeds)
plt.title('Top 10 Most Common Dog Breeds in Zurich')
plt.xlabel('Number of Dogs')
plt.ylabel('Dog Breed')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
